_readme: Every image slot on the site. To fill a slot, save the image in src/assets/images/ with the slot's file name (any of .jpg .jpeg .png .webp .avif); the site resizes and converts it at build time. A slot with no file shows nothing. Supply at least minWidth pixels wide at the given aspect ratio. status 'now' = page is live; 'later' = page is still a draft. realPhotoOnly = must be a real photo from a FreshStart job (Google and customers treat these as proof).
_brand: Crew wear a deep teal (#0E4F4A) polo or shirt with a small apricot (#FF9A5C) accent and a plain cap or hairnet; no other company logos, no readable house numbers, gate numbers or plate numbers.

home-hero.alt: Two cleaners wiping a kitchen counter and mopping the floor in a Fairview home
home-hero.scene: Bright, tidy kitchen-dining area of a middle-class house-and-lot in Fairview, Quezon City: tiled floor, ceramic-tiled backsplash, electric fan, rice cooker on the counter. Two Filipino cleaners, a woman in her 30s and a man in his 20s, in teal uniform polos, gloves on, one wiping the counter, one mopping. Natural daylight from a window with grills. Warm, friendly, candid; not posed at the camera.

home-booking.alt: Homeowner in Quezon City checking a cleaning quote on her phone while a cleaner works in the background
home-booking.scene: A Filipina homeowner in her 40s in casual home clothes sits at a wooden dining table holding a phone, smiling at a chat screen (no readable app branding). In the soft-focus background a FreshStart cleaner in a teal polo dusts a living-room shelf. Townhouse interior with a sala set and a wall clock.

about-team.alt: The FreshStart cleaning crew with their equipment outside a house in northern Quezon City
about-team.scene: A real photo of the FreshStart crew (with their permission)

about-training.alt: A team lead showing a new cleaner the bathroom checklist during training
about-training.scene: A Filipina team lead in a teal polo holds a clipboard checklist and points at a bathroom sink while a younger Filipino trainee in the same uniform listens and takes notes. Clean white-tiled bathroom in a Quezon City home.

book-hero.alt: Cleaners arriving at a client's gate in Novaliches with their cleaning kit
book-hero.scene: Two Filipino cleaners in teal polos and company IDs on lanyards greet a homeowner at an open steel gate of a townhouse in Novaliches, carrying a caddy of supplies and a mop bucket. Tricycle passing in the background, everyday street, morning light.

og-default.page: All pages (link previews on Facebook, Messenger, Viber)
og-default.alt: Cleaners at work in a Quezon City home
og-default.scene: Wide shot, same style as the home hero: a Filipino cleaning team in teal polos working in a bright living room. Leave the left third calm (wall or window) so the shared link title stays readable over it.

house-cleaning.alt: Cleaner vacuuming the living room of a house in Greater Lagro, Quezon City
house-cleaning.scene: Living room of a single house in Greater Lagro: sala set, family photos (blurred), capiz or jalousie windows. A Filipina cleaner in a teal polo vacuums the rug while a second cleaner fluffs throw pillows.

house-cleaning/regular-cleaning-plans.alt: Cleaner making the bed in a Quezon City townhouse bedroom
house-cleaning/regular-cleaning-plans.scene: Neat bedroom in a North Fairview townhouse. A Filipina cleaner in a teal polo smooths a fresh bedsheet and arranges pillows; folded towels on the bed. Calm, homely, routine-visit feel.

house-cleaning/deep-cleaning.alt: Cleaner scrubbing kitchen tile grout during a deep clean in Fairview
house-cleaning/deep-cleaning.scene: Close-medium shot in a Filipino home kitchen: a cleaner in gloves and a teal polo scrubs tile grout and the range hood; cabinet doors open, spray bottle and microfiber cloths on the counter. Shows thoroughness.

house-cleaning/move-in-move-out-cleaning.alt: Two cleaners cleaning an empty apartment after move-out in Quezon City
house-cleaning/move-in-move-out-cleaning.scene: Empty apartment unit (no furniture) in Kaligayahan or Novaliches: bare tiled floor, open windows. Two Filipino cleaners in teal polos, one wiping window tracks, one mopping; a couple of moving boxes by the door.

house-cleaning/post-renovation-cleaning.alt: Cleaner removing construction dust and paint marks after a home renovation in Quezon City
house-cleaning/post-renovation-cleaning.scene: Freshly renovated room with new tiles and white walls, dust on surfaces, a ladder in the corner. A Filipino cleaner in a teal polo, dust mask and gloves scrapes paint spots off the floor tiles; another vacuums dust with an industrial vacuum.

house-cleaning/after-party-clean-up.alt: Cleaners collecting garbage and stacking chairs the morning after a party in a Quezon City home
house-cleaning/after-party-clean-up.scene: Morning after a family celebration in a covered garage or sala: monobloc chairs, a folding table, leftover balloons and a birthday banner (no names). Two Filipino cleaners in teal polos bag garbage and stack chairs.

commercial-cleaning.alt: Cleaner disinfecting desks in a small office in Fairview, Quezon City
commercial-cleaning.scene: Small office (6 to 10 desks) above a shop along Regalado Avenue style street: computers off, early-morning light. A Filipino cleaner in a teal polo wipes desks with disinfectant while a colleague empties bins.

commercial-cleaning/office-cleaning.alt: Cleaner mopping the floor of a small office in Novaliches before opening hours
commercial-cleaning/office-cleaning.scene: A Filipina cleaner in a teal polo mops a small office floor with a yellow wet-floor sign; chairs pushed in, a pantry corner with a water dispenser.

commercial-cleaning/clinic-cleaning.alt: Cleaner in gloves disinfecting a dental clinic waiting area in Fairview
commercial-cleaning/clinic-cleaning.scene: Small dental or medical clinic waiting area: plastic chairs, reception counter, a plant. A Filipino cleaner in a teal polo, gloves and mask, wipes the reception counter and door handles. No patients present.

commercial-cleaning/shop-restaurant-clea.alt: Cleaners wiping tables and mopping a small eatery after closing in Fairview
commercial-cleaning/shop-restaurant-clea.scene: Small carinderia or cafe after closing: chairs up on tables, stainless counter. Two Filipino cleaners in teal polos mop the floor and degrease the counter. No signage text visible.

property-management/landlord-turnover-cl.alt: Cleaner photographing a cleaned apartment for the landlord's turnover report in Quezon City
property-management/landlord-turnover-cl.scene: Empty, freshly cleaned apartment unit. A Filipino team lead in a teal polo takes a photo of the clean bathroom with a phone for the photo report; a cleaner coils a vacuum cord behind.

property-management/vacant-unit-care.alt: Staff airing out and checking a vacant house in Lagro
property-management/vacant-unit-care.scene: A closed-up single house in Greater Lagro: a Filipino FreshStart staff member in a teal polo opens windows, another checks a faucet; sheets over some furniture. Calm, caretaking feel.

property-management/airbnb-turnover-clea.alt: Cleaner preparing a short-stay condo unit for the next guest in Fairview
property-management/airbnb-turnover-clea.scene: Stylish compact condo unit near Fairview: a Filipina cleaner in a teal polo places fresh towels folded on the bed and a welcome card on the side table; a second cleaner restocks the kitchenette.

pressure-washing.alt: Cleaner pressure washing a concrete driveway in Greater Lagro
pressure-washing.scene: Gated driveway of a house-and-lot in Greater Lagro: a Filipino cleaner in a teal polo, boots and safety glasses uses a pressure washer, leaving a visibly clean stripe on darker concrete.

pressure-washing/driveway-garage-washing.alt: Garage floor being pressure washed to remove oil stains in Quezon City
pressure-washing/driveway-garage-washing.scene: Carport with an oil-stained concrete floor; a Filipino cleaner pressure washes it, half clean and half dirty. No vehicle plates visible.

pressure-washing/wall-fence-washing.alt: Soft washing moss off a perimeter wall in Quezon City
pressure-washing/wall-fence-washing.scene: Perimeter concrete wall with green moss streaks; a Filipino cleaner soft-washes it with low pressure, clear before-and-after line visible.

car-detailing.alt: Cleaner foam washing a car at the owner's gate in Fairview
car-detailing.scene: Sedan parked in front of a gate in a Fairview subdivision; a Filipino cleaner in a teal polo foam-washes it with a mitt. Plate not visible.

car-detailing/home-car-wash.alt: Hand drying an SUV after a home car wash in Novaliches
car-detailing/home-car-wash.scene: SUV in a driveway; a Filipino cleaner hand-dries it with a microfiber towel, tyre shine bottle nearby.

car-detailing/interior-detailing.alt: Cleaner shampooing car seats during interior detailing at home
car-detailing/interior-detailing.scene: Open car door; a Filipino cleaner extracts dirt from a fabric seat with a spray extractor wand.

upholstery-cleaning.alt: Cleaner shampooing a fabric sofa in a Quezon City living room
upholstery-cleaning.scene: Fabric 3-seater sofa in a sala; a Filipino cleaner in a teal polo uses a spray extractor; a clean stripe shows on the cushion.

upholstery-cleaning/sofa-cleaning.alt: Sofa being deep cleaned at home in Fairview
upholstery-cleaning/sofa-cleaning.scene: Close-medium shot of sofa cushion extraction, dirty water visible in the machine tank, homeowner's hand (no face) pointing at a stain.

upholstery-cleaning/mattress-cleaning.alt: Cleaner vacuuming and shampooing a mattress at home in Quezon City
upholstery-cleaning/mattress-cleaning.scene: Bare queen mattress in a bedroom; a Filipina cleaner in a teal polo runs an upholstery vacuum over it.

upholstery-cleaning/carpet-cleaning.alt: Office carpet being shampooed in Quezon City
upholstery-cleaning/carpet-cleaning.scene: Small office with carpet tiles; a Filipino cleaner shampoos the carpet with an extractor after hours.
